action.command:
set -a && . /workspace/.env && set +a
echo "=== MinIO buckets ==="; docker exec workspace-minio-1 sh -c 'ls -la /data 2>/dev/null; ls /data/* 2>/dev/null | head' 2>&1 | head -30
echo "=== MinIO health ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "live %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live
echo "=== Qdrant collections ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:6333/collections | head -c 1500

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "set -a && . /workspace/.env && set +a
echo "=== MinIO buckets ==="; docker exec workspace-minio-1 sh -c 'ls -la /data 2>/dev/null; ls /data/* 2>/dev/null | head' 2>&1 | head -30
echo "=== MinIO health ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "live %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:9000/minio/health/live
echo "=== Qdrant collections ==="; curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:6333/collections | head -c 1500", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check MinIO and Qdrant"}
